name: 96734 · Kailua, HI
findings: ZIP 96734 (Kailua) has 211 nonprofit organizations. 91 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 72 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 96734 (Kailua) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 18 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
